en: Hah! I train down here where no one can disturb me. Few ever find their way this deep.
You have the eyes of someone who wants to test their fists. Will you fight me?
Good! Show me what you and your Pokémon are made of!
Hah! Well fought! Your Pokémon fight as one with you.
I have a young fighter that needs a Trainer with a strong heart. Take it, and teach it well.
{player} received Tyrogue from the Karate Master!
It has the makings of three different fighters. Which one it becomes depends on how you raise it.
Your team is full. Make room, and I will give you my young fighter.
Then leave me to my training. Come back when your fists are ready.
How is the young fighter? Train it hard, and it will repay you.
